title: SLO trigger huntbook and dashboard for graceful-degradation cases
creator: Ariel Chang
description: Deliver a diagnostic dashboard and operational 'huntbook' that helps oncall and SREs quickly triage graceful-degradation incidents (e.g. elevated tail latency with successful responses, increased token drops, model kv-cache evictions, adaptive-batching-induced latency spikes). This work ties tracing hook enrichments, metric/log pipeline mappings, and concrete SLI/SLO rules together so alerts produce high-signal runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard view (Grafana) with 6 panels: end-to-end p50/p95/p99 latency by route, request success vs semantic-failure rate, token-emit rate, batch-size distribution over time, KV cache hit ratio, and upstream RPC throttling rate
Tracing hooks instrumented to add fields: inference.phase (tokenize|model|postprocess), batch.size, kv.cache_hit, fallback_model, grpc_status_code, http_status_code
Log enrichment pipeline routes extra keys into metrics (batch.size histogram, kv.cache_hit ratio) and tags traces for sample retention when p99 latency exceeded

Huntbook document embedded in dashboard with step-by-step triage flow, prioritized runbooks for: overload/backpressure, model-timeouts, model-error responses (400/422 semantic errors), transport errors (5xx/gRPC UNAVAILABLE), and degraded-quality fallbacks
Automated alert rule that fires with < 10% false positive rate on an historical 6-week dataset (verify with retrospective run on last 6 weeks)
success_metrics: MTTA (mean time to acknowledge) for graceful-degradation incidents reduced from 18m to <8m
MTTR reduced from 95m to <45m for incidents classified by this dashboard
Pager noise (alerts requiring manual dismissal) decreased by 30% for SLO-based alerts related to inference latency
Number of incidents escalated to model-team for unknown root cause reduced by 40%
tasks: Design Grafana panels and mockups (frontend + metrics team)
Add tracing hook fields in runtime: inference.phase, batch.size, kv.cache_hit, batch.queue_depth
Update OTLP pipeline to map batch.size->histogram and kv.cache_hit->ratio metric
Enrich logs with model backend latency and grpc/http status mapping code
Create query templates for p95/p99 by route and fallback_model attribution
Author huntbook with play-by-play triage steps and links to dashboards/PRs
Run retrospective with last 6 weeks data and tune alert thresholds to target <10% FP rate
Ship dashboard and runbook behind feature flag; iterate with oncall feedback
